title: Beyond a Single Structure: Exploring Multistate Protein Conformational Landscapes with AI Structure Prediction
description: 11 AI structure-prediction and sampling methods, 22,000 models (11,000 each for E. coli adenylate kinase, 1AKE, and Mad2, 1DUJ), compared with experimental open and closed states, with Boltz2 template-only refold confidence scores.
